design: Verify completed model, replay, inference, settlement, fill-detail and phase-presence evidence at the exact named artifacts. Require six dates and three scenarios, all five policies, zero-floor and age500 smoke controls, and recompute declared objective booleans from paired values. Bind hashes and actual parquet row counts; do not refit or change any statistic or policy.
limits: Integrity and completeness instrument, not a new independent statistical estimator or live validation. Existing numerical reconciliation/forecast audits remain the sources for their claims. A PASS can accompany a negative model result. Full human interpretation and goal completion audit remain required.
controls: Complete coverage accepted; missing/duplicate coverage refused. Correct artifact hash accepted; altered bytes refused. Positive strategy predicate accepted; planted contradictory improvement refused. Real first-day run checked separately before the full chain is available.
